verses.text: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
lines: I will bless Yahweh at all times.
His praise will always be in my mouth.

verses.text: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
lines: My soul shall boast in Yahweh.
The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

verses.text: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
lines: Oh magnify Yahweh with me.
Let’s exalt his name together.

verses.text: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
lines: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me,
and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.text: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
lines: They looked to him, and were radiant.
Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

verses.text: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
lines: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him,
and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.text: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
lines: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him,
and delivers them.

verses.text: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
lines: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good.
Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

verses.text: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
lines: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints,
for there is no lack with those who fear him.

verses.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
lines: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger,
but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

verses.text: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
lines: Come, you children, listen to me.
I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

verses.text: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
lines: Who is someone who desires life,
and loves many days, that he may see good?

verses.text: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
lines: Keep your tongue from evil,
and your lips from speaking lies.

verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
lines: Depart from evil, and do good.
Seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.text: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
lines: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous.
His ears listen to their cry.

verses.text: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
lines: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil,
to cut off their memory from the earth.

verses.text: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
lines: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears,
and delivers them out of all their troubles.

verses.text: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
lines: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart,
and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

verses.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
lines: Many are the afflictions of the righteous,
but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

verses.text: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
lines: He protects all of his bones.
Not one of them is broken.

verses.text: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
lines: Evil shall kill the wicked.
Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

verses.text: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
lines: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants.
None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
